DESCRIPTION: Datagrama's 2024 edit of the classic Syn Scene Biopsy. The growth pattern was created by Felix Woitzel, and is generated by three stacked Reaction Diffusion systems that use his sophisticated Pyramid Blur technique. We made it move and gave it color. Reaction Diffusion systems look organic and natural because they are. The same system that is simulated here governs chemical reactions that give rise to tropical fish coloration, zebra stripes, coral shapes, and much more. Created by Meebs + Flexi
